decision.title: card-layout
decision.chose: A card is ai/2026/MM/DD/<slug>/page.jsonl; year, month and day are index pages; the card id is its path under ai/.
decision.alternative: A day index file ai/2026/MM/DD.jsonl with loose card files (the owner's first idea); rejected because a card with children would then have to change shape.

decision.title: card-writer
decision.chose: Servex writes card folders through a new Servex/cards/Cards.js with one promise chain per file, so it stays the single writer.
decision.alternative: The dev server's Append.js; rejected because agents talk to Servex, and the forward-to-attached-agents step needs the agent host.

decision.title: card-views
decision.chose: Today, open work and projects (tags) are one Servex route, GET /cards?view=, that folds every card's log.
decision.alternative: The browser walks year, month and day indexes and fetches each card; kept as the fallback if Servex is down.

log.msg: A sent its provisional API: line 1 names the class, {"file":"slug/page.jsonl"} lists a child, Page.jsonl(url) loads one. Concurrency handed Assistant.js and Dispatcher.js edits to me. Spawned minion-card-store (Opus) and minion-card-migrate (Sonnet).

decision.title: prompt-record
decision.chose: An owner prompt is its own line verb, {"prompt": {id, at, by, raw, text, via, on, url}}, merged by id so the cleaned reading lands as a second line; cited anywhere as <card id>#<prompt id>.
decision.alternative: A message with kind prompt; rejected because the owner wants every prompt to be a first-class quotation record, and a kind is easy to lose among replies.

decision.title: Card.js built on module A's loader now, not as a stopgap
decision.chose: Card extends Page, built by Page.jsonl() from the card's own folder; AI 2's year/month/day pages (Card.Folder) and Card.child() read each next folder down, so any depth works with nothing probed.

decision.alternative: Name the new class file something else; rejected because Servex writes "class": "/framework/ai2/Card.js" on line 1 of every card, including the 319 migrated ones.

decision.title: The rail lists top-level cards only
decision.chose: Sub-cards are listed inside their own card; view/all/ lists every card including sub-cards.
decision.alternative: Every folder card in the rail; rejected because a sub-card made inside a card jumped to the top of the rail as a separate row.

decision.title: Views filter the one list AI 2 already holds
decision.chose: view/<word>/ filters GET /cards?view=all with the same rules as Cards.list(), so a view keeps up live with no second request.
decision.alternative: One GET /cards?view=<word> per view page; rejected as a second, non-live copy of the same data.

assign.outcome:
**Every card is now its own folder, and agents on a card share its log.**

![A card, its sub-card and each chat](/framework/ai/2026-09-24/card-folders/card-with-sub.png)

- A card lives at `ai/2026/MM/DD/<slug>/page.jsonl`, dated by the day it was made. A sub-card is a folder inside it, to any depth. Try it: [a migrated card on AI 2](/framework/ai2/2026/09/24/topic-mufuomsy/).
- Its type is a line in its log, and the latest line wins. The type picker on each card appends one.
- Servex is the only writer. Agents make cards with `create_card` and read them with `read_card`, `attach_card` and `list_cards` ([Servex/cards/readme.md](/Servex/cards/readme.md) defines every line).
- Each owner prompt is its own record: the verbatim words, the cleaned words, when, and where it was said.
- An attached agent gets the card's whole log once, then every new owner prompt on it. Task masterminds are attached to their card; minions never are.
- All 326 old cards are migrated and committed (34 prompts, 20 messages, 9 titles recovered). The old logs and `board.jsonl` are kept.
- A card lists its own `.md` files and opens one in place.

Left: groups and embedding task pages in a card went to task-mastermind-ai2-dashboard, and the per-card agents panel to task-mastermind-assistant-layers. A doc swapped into a card has no side padding (the md-pages swap block).
